reason: ₱1,800 is a lot more than what I usually pay for gel art at the mall, and honestly for regular months Shopee press-ons look good enough. The wedding is next year, so I don't need to book anything right now.
objection: It's a new business and I pick my nail artist by their portfolio. I haven't seen their work, so I'm not paying a premium for someone I can't check on IG or TikTok first.
would_change_my_mind: A strong Instagram or TikTok portfolio with real client photos, plus an entourage group rate for my sister's wedding.
